job.resolved_prompt:
如题。
etcd打开了rbac authentication。但discov.EtcdConf中没有user等字段，无法进行身份认证。连接etcd时会报错：
etcdserver: user name is empty
followups: Allow discovery clients to authenticate to etcd when the server has RBAC authentication enabled, while keeping existing unauthenticated configurations working.

Carry the etcd username and password from discovery configuration to both client construction and the publisher path used by RPC server registration. Treat authentication as enabled only when both credentials are present, and reject a configuration that provides just one.

Add optional User and Pass fields to EtcdConf with paired-value validation and an EnableAuth check. Thread credentials through registry GetConnWithAuth and MonitorWithAuth, cluster creation, and NewClient/DialClient into the etcd client's Username and Password configuration. Expose discov.NewPublisherWithAuth and Publisher.KeepAliveWithAuth, add internal.NewRpcPubServerWithEtcdAuth, and select that publication path from zrpc.NewServer when authentication is enabled. Preserve existing unauthenticated construction, validation, and server options.

type cluster struct {
	endpoints  []string
	key        string
	user       string
	password   string
	values     map[string]map[string]string
	listeners  map[string][]UpdateListener
	watchGroup *threading.RoutineGroup
	done       chan lang.PlaceholderType
	lock       sync.Mutex
}

func newCluster(endpoints []string, user, password string) *cluster {
	return &cluster{
		endpoints:  endpoints,
		key:        getClusterKey(endpoints),
		user:       user,
		password:   password,
		values:     make(map[string]map[string]string),
		listeners:  make(map[string][]UpdateListener),
		watchGroup: threading.NewRoutineGroup(),
		done:       make(chan lang.PlaceholderType),
	}
}
